{
  "name": "nanoevents",
  "version": "10.0.0",
  "description": "Simple and tiny (108 bytes) event emitter library",
  "keywords": [
    "EventEmitter",
    "Events",
    "emit",
    "emitter",
    "event",
    "pub/sub",
    "publish",
    "reactor",
    "subscribe"
  ],
  "license": "MIT",
  "author": "Andrey Sitnik <andrey@sitnik.ru>",
  "repository": "ai/nanoevents",
  "type": "module",
  "sideEffects": false,
  "types": "./index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": "./index.js",
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "test:coverage": "bnt --coverage 100 --coverage-exclude '**/*.test.*' --coverage-exclude 'test/*'",
    "test:lint": "oxlint",
    "test:types": "check-dts",
    "test:size": "size-limit",
    "test": "pnpm run /^test:/"
  },
  "funding": [
    {
      "type": "github",
      "url": "https://github.com/sponsors/ai"
    }
  ],
  "devDependencies": {
    "@logux/oxc-configs": "^0.4.1",
    "@size-limit/preset-small-lib": "^12.1.0",
    "@types/node": "^26.1.1",
    "actions-up": "^1.16.0",
    "better-node-test": "^0.8.4",
    "check-dts": "^2.0.0",
    "eslint-plugin-prefer-let": "^4.2.2",
    "oxlint": "^1.74.0",
    "oxlint-tsgolint": "^7.0.2001",
    "size-limit": "^12.1.0",
    "tinybench": "^6.0.2",
    "typescript": "^7.0.2"
  },
  "size-limit": [
    {
      "import": "{ createNanoEvents }",
      "limit": "108 B"
    }
  ],
  "engines": {
    "node": "^22.0.0 || ^24.0.0 || >=26.0.0"
  }
}
